summary: 500 Global’s Flagship Accelerator page is public and describes a 4-month in-person San Francisco program with mentorship, growth programming, demo day, community, and investment terms, but the current public page does not publish an application deadline or upcoming cohort dates. The application portal returns an expired-page message, so no current application window can be verified.

sources.title: 500 Global Flagship Accelerator Program
sources.supports: Official page supports that the Flagship Accelerator is a 4-month in-person program in San Francisco with curriculum, 1:1 mentorship, community, demo day, and stated investment terms of $150,000 for 6% less a $37,500 program fee.

sources.title: 500 Flagship Accelerator Application Portal
sources.supports: Application portal currently displays that the page has expired, supporting that a current public application window could not be verified.

notes: No exact application_open, application_close, program_start, program_end, or demo_day dates were found on the official public accelerator page.
Because the supplied apply_url is expired and no current cohort date is public, this should not be merged as an upcoming event without manual review.

If future dates are later published, a mergeable event would likely use type accelerator, supports funding/mentorship/resources, sector general, location San Francisco, and date_range_text reflecting the 4-month in-person cadence.
